title: CodewardConfig
description: Configuration schema for Codeward multi-agent code reviewer and security auditor

$schema.description: Link to the JSON schema for validation and autocompletion

provider.description: Default LLM provider to use for agent reviews

model.description: Override default model name (e.g. gpt-4o, claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022, gemini-2.0-flash, deepseek-coder:6.7b)

apiUrl.description: Custom API base URL for proxies or OpenAI-compatible backends

failOn.description: Severity threshold that triggers a non-zero exit code to block CI builds

agents.description: List of agents to enable (security, logic, performance)

exclude.description: File or glob patterns to ignore during code review

customPrompt.description: Team-specific guidelines or architectural constraints injected into all review agents

maxCritical.description: Maximum tolerated critical issues before failing

maxWarning.description: Maximum tolerated warning issues before failing
